items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: That is to say he made some arrangements for Cozy Cole, as I said. We recorded them and I got to know him

ctx.x: Aside from Chano Pozo, who you've spoken of earlier, did you work with other Latin musicians?]

Chico Farrell, you know, the arranger. I became quite friendly with him. That is to say he made some arrangements for Cozy Cole, as I said. We recorded them and I got to know him and he's a great arranger.
What was/some of the material that you worked on with him?
